main.title: Stanford CS224N: Natural Language Processing with Deep Learning
main.why: Word vectors, parsing, language models, translation, Transformers and pretraining. In English.

main.title: Term Weighting Approaches in Automatic Text Retrieval
main.why: Not every word matters equally for retrieval, so TF-IDF weights each term by its frequency in the document and its rarity in the collection.

main.title: Simple, Proven Approaches to Text Retrieval
main.why: Raw term counts favor long documents, so BM25 combines IDF with saturating term frequency and length normalization, still Elasticsearch's default.

main.title: Two Decades of Statistical Language Modeling: Where Do We Go from Here?
main.why: N-gram language models were the workhorse of speech recognition and translation, and this survey covers perplexity, smoothing and the fixes tried for their weaknesses.

main.title: A Neural Probabilistic Language Model
main.why: N-gram models cannot generalize to unseen word sequences, so this neural language model learns word vectors that share statistics across similar words.
Neural language models were too slow to train on large corpora, so word2vec learns word vectors with the simple skip-gram and CBOW objectives.

further.title: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation

main.title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
main.why: Neural networks needed fixed-size inputs and outputs, so seq2seq uses one LSTM to encode the source sentence and another to decode the translation.

main.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
main.why: Squeezing a sentence into one fixed vector hurt long translations, so attention lets the decoder search the source at every step.

main.title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units
main.why: A fixed word vocabulary cannot cover rare words, so BPE splits them into frequent subword units.

main.title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
main.why: Labeled data is scarce, so GPT pretrains a Transformer decoder on unlabeled text and fine-tunes it for each task.
Left-to-right pretraining sees only the left context, so BERT pretrains an encoder that reads both directions by predicting masked words.

further.title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
DistilBERT, a Distilled Version of BERT: Smaller, Faster, Cheaper and Lighter
Unsupervised Cross-lingual Representation Learning at Scale
DeBERTa: Decoding-enhanced BERT with Disentangled Attention
Smarter, Better, Faster, Longer: A Modern Bidirectional Encoder for Fast, Memory Efficient, and Long Context Finetuning and Inference

main.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
main.why: GPT-2 shows that a large language model trained on web text handles many tasks zero-shot, without task-specific fine-tuning.

main.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
main.why: Transfer learning methods were hard to compare, so T5 casts every task as text in, text out and tests pretraining choices one at a time.

main.title: Connectionist Temporal Classification: Labelling Unsegmented Sequence Data with Recurrent Neural Networks
main.why: Speech data rarely has frame-level alignments, so CTC trains a recognizer directly on audio and its transcript.

main.title: wav2vec 2.0: A Framework for Self-Supervised Learning of Speech Representations
main.why: Transcribed speech is scarce, so wav2vec 2.0 pretrains on unlabeled audio and fine-tunes on a small labeled set.
Speech models trained on clean benchmarks broke on real audio, so Whisper trains on a vast amount of weakly labeled web audio and works without fine-tuning.

main.title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
main.why: Comparing sentence pairs with BERT is too slow for search, so Sentence-BERT embeds each sentence once and compares embeddings by cosine.

main.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
main.why: Term matching misses paraphrases, so DPR trains a dual encoder on question-passage pairs and retrieves by embedding similarity.

main.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
main.why: Knowledge stored in model weights is hard to update, so RAG retrieves passages with DPR and has BART write answers from them.
Term matching failed on natural-language podcast queries, so Spotify retrieves episodes with a fine-tuned multilingual sentence encoder.
